newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not established on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers: No confirmed sales
Dressed Basis Heifers: No confirmed sales

Trade continues at a standstill on slaughter cattle from the feedyards in Nebraska. No sales slaughter steers or heifers. Buyer inquiry and demand fairly good. Seller interest light even at bids that are higher than Monday. CME Futures closed higher and sellers taking an even firmer stance.
Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Confirmed: None Last Week: 6,100 Last Year: 23,800
Wk To Date: 3,100 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 10,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr: 30,700
